Physics and Astronomy
Physics and Astronomy
Royal Holloway physicist helps unlock cosmic clues in landmark neutrino study
Particle physicist Dr Asher Kaboth has helped deliver one of the most precise neutrino measurements to date and published in 'Nature'.
Studying here
Study for undergraduate (BSc and MSci) and postgraduate (MSc, MRes or PhD) at one of the UK’s most celebrated centres for Physics and Astronomy.
Research degrees (Master & PhD)
Discover research degrees that span a wide range of fundamental and applied areas of Physics.
About us
Welcome to Physics and Astronomy. General contact information, information for alumni, and our commitment to equality and diversity
Studying here
Choose to study undergraduate and postgraduate opportunities at one of the UK’s most celebrated centres for Physics and Astronomy
Research
Get involved in world-class research in condensed matter physics, quantum technologies, particle physics, accelerator science and theoretical physics
Careers
Find out about careers after studying physics, potentially in high technology industry, academic research, finance and more. There is also information in career support and graduate destinations.
Lecturer in Physics
Professor Andrew Casey
“Our cutting-edge research underpins teaching, creating an inspiring learning community for our students.”
